events.title: Play the free demo and join the Capital Criminal community
events.summary: Try the free Windows demo Capital Criminal is an indie economic strategy game inspired by classic DOS games. Compare market prices, travel between cities and manage your money, debt and risks. The free Windows demo is available on our Steam store page. Choose “Download Demo” to install it. The full game is still coming soon; adding it to your wishlist helps you follow its release.
